# List of international presidential trips made by Mohamed Waheed Hassan

This is a list of presidential international trips made by Mohamed Waheed Hassan Manik as the 5th president of the Maldives from February 2012 to November 2013.
At the end of his presidential term, Manik made 13 trips to 12 countries.
